sources.title: Claybook GDC 2018
sources.locator: Slides 20 and 21; PDF pages 19 and 20 zero-based
sources.finding: Limited-range multilevel fields permit sparse modification; previous data and temporary tiles are reused.
sources.boundary: Different field encoding and mip representation; no Cubey timings or direct code transfer.

sources.title: FidelityFX Brixelizer 1.0 manual
sources.locator: Acceleration Structure Construction, Low Level Updating a Cascade, persistent resources
sources.finding: Explicit invalidation jobs, stable brick IDs, bounded work resources and traversal rebuilding.
sources.boundary: Triangle-input unsigned distance generation; not an authored hard-CSG updater.

sources.title: Lipschitz Pruning 2025 author manuscript
sources.finding: Regional operator dominance uses a 2R separation bound; partial pruning updates are future work.
sources.boundary: Cubey regional sampling failed raw cache identity. The new active-brick bound is our conditional derivation, not an implementation claim from the paper.

sources.title: MIT Constructive Solid Geometry Methods
sources.finding: Ray intersection surface limits compose under Boolean operations.
sources.boundary: Does not establish native Cached epsilon, normals, shading or multi-edit cost.

sources.title: Khronos Vulkan synchronization examples
sources.finding: Execution and memory dependencies must be explicit between producer and reader work.
sources.boundary: Correct synchronization does not imply a maximum GPU maintenance duration.

sources.title: Khronos Vulkan queues
sources.finding: Different queues require synchronization and need not correspond to independently executing hardware.
sources.boundary: No async-compute speedup or preemption guarantee is assumed.

sources.title: Khronos vkCmdCopyImage
sources.finding: Explicit regions can copy between compatible images.
sources.boundary: Source/destination usage, layout, format and dependencies must be valid. No latency prediction.

sources.title: Khronos vkCmdCopyBuffer
sources.finding: Explicit byte regions can be copied with transfer usage and non-overlapping storage.
sources.boundary: Does not supply queue admission or runtime budget guarantees.

scope: Primary sources; no donor benchmark reproduced and no donor code copied
